style: Modern Stylized 2D game art with subtle Cartoon Adventure personality, polished, colorful, premium, playful but never childish; clean consistent dark navy outlines; smooth soft shading; rounded shapes; strong contrast; readable at small size. Fully transparent background, no ground shadow, no text, no frame, no scenery, centered, subject fills most of the canvas. Avoid photorealism, pixel art, flat corporate vector.
backgroundStyle: wide horizontally seamless underwater PARALLAX BACKGROUND layer for a 2D side-scrolling game. Only distant, soft, slightly hazy background elements, lower contrast than gameplay so foreground sprites stay readable, no characters, no treasure, no text, no UI, no water surface visible. Left and right edges must match so it tiles horizontally. Modern Stylized 2D cartoon adventure style, smooth soft shading.
